text:
Harper: Found a mysterious mug on the window sill that says "Do Not Steal" but it has faint glitter on the handle. Who claims this masterpiece? :coffee:
Nina: That's mine! I left it there while I rescued a plant. Thank you for noticing, steward of dishes. :sparkles:
Omar: Small victory: mug returned without requiring a ransom. Kudos, Harper.
Dina: Also kudos to Nina for plant rescue. Who knew the ficus preferred indie rock and minimal sunlight?
Kofi: Shoutout to the plant and mug diplomacy committee. I will craft a tiny label: "Nina's glitter mug (not for stealing)"
Harper: Suggestion: can we add a simple mug registry? Name + emoji + preferred beverage. Saves mystery ownership.
OpsBot: Reminder: Shared kitchen items should be labeled. Proposal accepted: add a pinned spreadsheet in #general for mug registration. :clipboard:
Nina: I support the registry. My entry: Nina | :coffee: | glitter handle | emergency cookie negotiator: Kofi
Omar: Entry: Omar | :tea: | chipped rim | mood: existential
Dina: Entry: Dina | :matcha: | tiny spoon required | allergies: none
Kofi: Entry: Kofi | :espresso: | tiny heart sticker | barter currency: hot chips
SnackBot: New poll by Harper: "Mug registry: keep it?" 1: Yes, 2: No, 3: Make it a sticker wall. Poll ends in 24h.
Harper: Also tiny rule: if you borrow a mug, please rinse and leave it upside down if drying. Tiny cooperative rituals, big happiness.
Nina: If the registry exists, can we have a column for "last cleaned by" so we can shame and/or celebrate hygienic heroes.
Omar: I'll build a tiny Google sheet template. Will post link. Low friction or it's not happening.
Dina: Can we have a one-line tooltip: "If it smells like garlic, return with apology note."
Kofi: I will draw a tiny pixel crown for the cleanest mug each month. Prize: one coffee on me.
OpsBot: Action: pinned "Mug registry" spreadsheet will be posted in 1h. Please add your mug if you have one.
Harper: Thanks all. Mystery resolved, glitter restored to rightful owner, and culture nudged toward basic civility. Closing thread. :raised_hands:
